response.rationale: Applicable rules: RET-007 (eligible, priority 10) since within 30 days and not final sale; RET-050 (goodwill grant, eligible, priority 50); RET-051 (fraud hold, ineligible, priority 50). RET-012 and RET-020 do not apply (not final sale, not defective). RET-002/003/008 do not apply. Between the two highest-priority applicable rules (both priority 50), RET-051's fraud hold controls: accounts under fraud hold are not eligible for returns pending review, which blocks the return regardless of the goodwill grant.
